note: For 1 <= i <= t (e = i-1) [L] bounds the distance in V_t from the limit to the preimage of the lower-degree image, not the quotient distance in F_t, with the constant C_{t,i}(m) written as fare and a_ref^(t-i) absorbed in it. The case i = 0 (F_{-1}=0) is not in limit_cap; it is whole_origin at finite cutoff.

lemma limit_cap (v : Rowe C d) (x : C.label d) {b : Filter Cutoffs} [b.NeBot] {z : ℝ}
    (hp : b ≤ f.fuse) (hk:C.ref d ≤ k)
    (hz : ∀ᶠ i in b, quota C d k i.1 i.2 (v i) ≤ z) (hx : Tendsto v b (𝓝 x)) :
    ∃ y : C.label d, S.project d y ∈ LinearMap.range (X.rise he.le) ∧ ‖x-y‖ ≤ fare C k d e*z := by
